metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to change decimal separator from dot to comma in LibreOffice Calc by selecting A2:B20, opening Format Cells, and changing locale to Dutch (Netherlands). Agent failed after step 13 because the display didn't update and it got stuck clicking cell A2 repeatedly for 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent demonstrated: selecting cell ranges (A2:B20), right-click context menus, opening Format Cells dialog, navigating language dropdowns, and pressing OK. Basic sheet navigation confirmed reliable.
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent changed Format Cells language to Dutch (Netherlands) which showed correct preview (0,1) but displayed values still used dots. The agent got confused and repeatedly clicked cell A2 without making progress. Failure was due to misunderstanding between display locale and stored format.
